tasks.title: Draft PO for 50 t of Vietnam-spec hay for Bowmans before 5 December
Confirm Bowmans capacity and QC release
Confirm carrier booking and ETA for arrival by 15 December
Check the purchase commitment against budget

final:
G-001 is 50 tonnes short for Saigon Dairy Co.  
Procurement will draft the PO for 50 tonnes by 27 November. Finance will check the commitment by 30 November.  
Sales Fulfilment will confirm the carrier booking and ETA by 1 December.  
Production will confirm Bowmans capacity and QC release by 4 December, after Procurement completes its task.  
The plan is submitted and awaits your approval.
